nodes.label: MACD Real Chart EUR/USD H1
nodes.description: Two-panel chart showing MACD(12,26,9) applied to real EUR/USD H1 candlestick data. Top panel: price candlestick chart (range ~1.1600-1.1800). Bottom panel: MACD line (blue), Signal line (orange/Сигнальная), and histogram bars (green above zero, red below zero). Title in Russian: 'MACD (12, 26, 9) — РЕАЛЬНЫЕ данные EUR/USD H1'. Approximately 150 candles visible.

nodes.label: EUR/USD Currency Pair
nodes.description: EUR/USD forex pair used as the underlying instrument in the MACD real data chart.

nodes.label: MACD Indicator (12,26,9)
nodes.description: MACD technical indicator with parameters fast=12, slow=26, signal=9. Shown as MACD line (blue) and signal line (orange) with histogram.

nodes.label: MACD Signal Line
nodes.description: Signal line (Сигнальная) shown in orange on MACD chart, representing 9-period EMA of MACD line.

nodes.label: MACD Histogram
nodes.description: Histogram bars showing difference between MACD and signal lines. Green bars above zero line, red bars below zero line.

nodes.label: H1 Timeframe
nodes.description: 1-hour (H1) timeframe used for the EUR/USD candlestick data in the MACD real example chart.
